_about: DES1 (2026-11-08): per map, its own cards, the skills it introduces (NEW on the main road; side maps apart), basics coverage and the proposal. Generated by tools/des1/map_signatures_2026_11_08.py from canonical/cards.json, canonical/map-pools.json, canonical/skill-delivery.json and the game export (tools/export_gamedata.py). Analysis only: nothing here changes the game.

definitions.newMain: first main-road list (Tutorial, Maps 0-20 in unlock order) whose cards carry the skill (base or any level)
definitions.newSide: on a side map and on no earlier main or side list
definitions.signatureCandidate: a new skill on 2+ cards of the list, not a drawback

proposal.theme: Teaches the basics, nothing else.
proposal.minor: Pounce (Golden Eagle Diver) as a preview.
proposal.moveLater: Dynamite and Landslide (Map 11 Eyrie Heights, with Avalanche); Spiteful / Counterattack (Thornwood Palisade: Map 1 Thistlewood, with Thorns); Venomous (Caustic Scorpion: Map 4); Swarm (Map 0); Regeneration, Bounty.
proposal.basics: Guardian ✗: a Guardian unit in T-3..T-5 (the Terrier Pup) so the three basics are all taught.

maps.name: Bramblewood Outskirts
maps.blurb: The first tree-line past the castle walls — mostly scouts and stragglers.

proposal.theme: Scouts and stragglers past the walls: bees and ants.
proposal.minor: Delivery (Beaver Lumberjack: the first resource).
proposal.note: Swarm becomes new here once the Tutorial stops showing it (Bee Warden). Map 0 is UI21's Swarm map already.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Acorn-pelter Squirrel (common 2/6, Arrow). Quick ½: Cottontail only; fine for Map 0.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: Thistlewood
maps.blurb: Thistle and fern under the first big trees — hedgerows, burrows and a lot of small, busy things.

proposal.theme: Hedgerows and burrows: small busy things that gather and prick.
proposal.minor: Inspiring (Cricket Drummer, the owner's pick), Thanatosis (Slow-worm: the owner's own one-off example), Pickpocket (Field Mouse).
proposal.moveLater: True Sight (Owl Sentinel) to Map 6, as Invisible's answer; Devour (Hollow-belly Rat) to Map 7 or 12; Lumberjack (Badger Lumberjack) and Timbered (Woodcock Lookout) to Map 13 Redwood Deep with Milling; Crepuscular (Woodcock) to Map 7. Injured is a drawback: no count.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Quill-flinger Porcupine (uncommon 2/10, Arrow + Thorns) fills ranged and gives Thorns its second carrier.

maps.name: Pebble Beach
maps.blurb: Where the fields run out into sand — rock pools, gulls and things in shells.

proposal.theme: Rock pools and shells: the tide and the things that hide in shells.
proposal.minor: Pierce (Oystercatcher: the Armor answer, keep beside it).
proposal.moveLater: Sonar (Dolphin Outrider) to Map 8 Caves & Alcoves, where sound is the theme.
proposal.note: Tide is new on the Tutorial today (Silver Minnow, Level 1); Pebble Beach is its UI21 map and has 6 carriers.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Shell-drop Gull (common 1/7, Flying + Arrow). Quick ✗: Fleetfoot'd (otter, Tide + Quick).

maps.name: Gannet Cliffs
maps.blurb: Where the beach climbs into sheer white cliffs, and every ledge belongs to a bird.

proposal.theme: Every ledge belongs to a bird: strikes from above, and the spear that answers them.
proposal.minor: Reload (Peak Condor).
proposal.moveLater: Mountain Climber (Red-billed Chough) to Map 11 Eyrie Heights; Cleave (Tomcat) to Map 16 Taiga (3 Cleave carriers there); Shell + Shield (Conch Crawler) to Smugglers' Grotto or minor; Bleed (Razorbill) to Map 10 with Gash, or minor.
proposal.note: **The owner's Reach idea fits here** (ENG37): a wooden-spear animal with Reach. Reach can't be dodged by Flying, so on a map with 10 flyers it is the player's answer: a lesson, not just a card. Reach reads '?' on starters until Map 1 (Meerkat Wayfarer); this map makes it a strategy. Add a Dive carrier too: a gannet (Gannet Nestweaver) plunge-dives.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: the Reach spear card fills it. Guardian ½ (Fiddler Crab Swarm): fine.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: Sunken Hollow
maps.blurb: A flooded lowland — reef-runners and things that never surface first.

proposal.theme: A flooded lowland: shields that hold, poison that waits, algae that spreads.
proposal.minor: Twin Strike (Alley Cat).
proposal.note: Venomous has 3 carriers here but is new on the Tutorial (Caustic Scorpion). Bloom needs a second carrier (Pond Algae only).
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Electric Catfish (rare 2/8, Spark). Quick ✗: give the Water Shrew Quick, or Fleetfoot'd if not used on Map 2.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: Gatorback Swamp
maps.blurb: A warm, green, very much alive swamp — toads, leeches and logs that open their eyes.

proposal.theme: A living swamp: logs that open their eyes, hunters that finish the poisoned.
proposal.minor: Repair (Cypress Root Lurker); Cower (Box Turtle, half drawback).
proposal.moveEarlier: Ambush from The Sunken Grove / Map 17 to here: the Crocodile Ambusher and Swamp Alligator are 'logs that open their eyes'. Cull (Hunter: Poisoned) needs a second carrier.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Reed-dart Bittern (uncommon 2/5, Arrow + Stealth). Quick ½ (Anhinga Pounce): fine.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: Sable Swampmire
maps.blurb: A second, blacker wetland — everything here bites first and asks later.

proposal.theme: A blacker wetland: things you can't see, and the doctor who keeps you alive.
proposal.minor: Daunt (Booming Bittern's second skill), Immunity (Venomlord Serpent), Weaken (Lamprey).
proposal.moveLater: Predator (Marsh Harrier) to Map 14 Savanna, with Prey; Evasive (Camouflage Frog) to Map 17, where 5 cards have it; Tally (Raven Scout): swap for True Sight (as SKILLREC1 proposed); Sequestration: minor or later.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Venom Spit on the Poison Dart Croaker instead of Sequestration (a spitting frog). Quick ✗: Quick on the Adder Ambusher.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: Lilypad Reach
maps.blurb: A wide, still pond full of lily pads, beaver dams and very territorial ducks.

proposal.theme: Beaver dams and territorial ducks.
proposal.moveLater: Bulldoze (Victoria Regia) to Map 15 Long Grass, where the Bison Bulldozer owns it.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗ / Quick ✗: Mallard Marauder (rare 2/5, Flying + Pounce) for the ducks; Dam-Keeper Beaver (Rampart) gives Rampart its second carrier.

maps.name: The Morel Hollow
maps.blurb: A damp hollow under the old oaks, where the mushrooms grow taller than the otters.

proposal.theme: The mushroom hollow: rot, and things that multiply.
proposal.minor: Stealth (Owl Nightwatch: a night reveal), Meld (Leafcutter Gardener).
proposal.note: Read Meiosis (Planarian) and On Death spawn (Fungal Colossus) as part of the 'multiply' signature beside Brood, or demote them to minor.
proposal.moveLater: Deadly Poison (Cane Toad) to Map 18 or The Pale Desert (3 Venomous there); Wither (Corpse-flower Beetle): fold into Decay or minor.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Puffball Bombardier (uncommon 1/5, Arrow + Venomous + Bloom: a puffball for a mushroom map). Quick ✗: a hunting spider with Pounce.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: Smugglers' Grotto
maps.blurb: A sea cave under Pebble Beach. Whatever the smugglers left down here, something else has moved in.

proposal.theme: The smugglers' sea cave: webs in the dark.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Smuggler Slingrat (uncommon 1/5, Arrow + Stealth). Quick ✗: fine for a side map.

maps.name: Caves & Alcoves
maps.blurb: Deep beneath the Peak, where sound carries further than light does.

proposal.theme: Sound carries further than light: echoes against glow.
proposal.minor: Keen Sense (Quarry Mole; near Sonar), Bedrock (Quarry Mole), On Ready damage (Echo Screecher). Purblind is a drawback; Web came from Smugglers' Grotto.
proposal.moveEarlier: Sonar from Map 2 (Dolphin Outrider) to here; the Echo Screecher bat is its natural second carrier.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Bolas Spider (uncommon 2/8, Bola). Guardian ½ (Stalactite Pill Bug), Quick ½ (Giant Cave Huntsman): fine.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: The Mycelium Deep
maps.blurb: Under the Morel Hollow, the roots go down a long way, and every root is listening.

proposal.theme: Roots that listen: they sting whoever touches them.
proposal.minor: Rocket (Bombardier Beetle, also the side map's shooter). Slow is a drawback.
proposal.moveLater: Rage (Ant Warrior) to Map 13 Redwood Deep, its main home.

maps.name: The Kelp Mangroves
maps.blurb: Salt water creeps into the swamp — mangrove roots, kelp curtains and smugglers' channels.

proposal.theme: Salt water in the swamp: mudskippers and brackish shores.
proposal.minor: Taunt (Proboscis Monkey: a basic), Relict (Horseshoe Crab, a living fossil one-off).
proposal.note: Both signatures need a second carrier: Skitter on the Sunbittern Strider or Mangrove Monitor; Salt on a crab.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Trident Caiman (uncommon 4/11, Reach + Pierce). Quick ✗: Pounce on the Mangrove Kingfisher.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: Coral Current
maps.blurb: Past the last cliffs, the open sea — deep water, fast currents and the teeth that live in them.

proposal.theme: The open sea: tentacles that strike two ways and leave wounds.
proposal.minor: Charge (Electric Ray), Nova (Supernova Jelly: a forecast one-off).
proposal.note: Already the cleanest map: both signatures sit on the Colossal Squid and the Kraken Spawnling.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Snapgun Shrimp (common 1/7, Spark: a pistol shrimp). Quick ½ (Great Barracuda): fine.

maps.name: Eyrie Heights
maps.blurb: Sheer alpine cliffs above the Foundry’s smoke — the air here belongs to whatever can still fly in it.

proposal.theme: Alpine cliffs: climbers and the rockfall they start.
proposal.minor: Fletcher (Eagle-Owl Quartermaster).
proposal.moveEarlier: Mountain Climber becomes new here once it leaves Map 3 (2 carriers here already); Landslide joins from the Tutorial as a minor.
proposal.moveLater: Frostbite (Mountain Hare) to Map 17 Tundra (2 carriers there).
proposal.basics: Ranged ½: Stonecracker Vulture (uncommon 2/9, Flying + Arrow).

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: The Sunken Depths
maps.blurb: An otter ferry went down past the reef wall years ago. The current through its hull is faster than anything above.

proposal.theme: A sunken ferry in a fast current: octopus country.
proposal.minor: Nullify (Hagfish Silencer).
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Tidefolk Harpooner (rare 4/15, Reach + Tide).

maps.name: The Briar Maze
maps.blurb: Hedges taller than a heron, thorns sharper than a quill — and every turn is a dead end for someone.

proposal.theme: A maze: walls to break and corners to stab around.
proposal.minor: Confuse (Lyrebird Mimic).
proposal.moveLater: Scavenge (Carrion Crow) to Map 20 beside Carrion.
proposal.note: Siege needs a second carrier (Quill-Thorn Boar). The Mouse Sapper is the juke's teacher (feelings.md).
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Fox Sharpshot (common 4/11, Snipe; a fox beside the Cunning Vixen). Quick ✗: Quick on the Hedge Weasel.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: Clovermead
maps.blurb: A wide clover meadow past the Outskirts — rabbits, bees and mice, and nobody in a hurry.

proposal.theme: A slow clover meadow: no new skill, and that is fine.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: optional; a side map may skip it.

maps.name: The Redwood Deep
maps.blurb: Trees as wide as castles and as old as the hills — bears, stags and boars rule the red shade.

proposal.theme: Bears, stags and boars under red shade.
proposal.minor: Milling (Redwood Woodpecker), Fast Forward (Swift Fox).
proposal.moveEarlier: Rage from The Mycelium Deep to here (Berserker Boar). Lumberjack / Timbered from Map 1 would sit here as minors.
proposal.note: Berserk (Tasmanian Devil) overlaps Rage and is off-theme here: fold into Rage or move the Devil.
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Muntjac Barker (uncommon 2/11, Sentry; a deer). Quick ✗: Firetail Trickster (rare 1/11, Pounce; a fox).

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: The Sunken Grove
maps.blurb: Where the swamp swallowed an old forest. The trees still stand, up to their necks.

proposal.theme: A drowned forest: the herbalist's grove.
proposal.note: If Ambush moves to Map 5, this side map teaches only Herbalist (the limit).

maps.name: Savanna Reaches
maps.blurb: Open grassland past the Peak — nothing here hides for long.

proposal.theme: Open grassland: the hunt. Predators and the prey that dodge them.
proposal.minor: Twin Shot (Spitting Cobra, also the ranged basic), Drunk (Marula Elephant: a fun one-off), Executioner (Grave-Grin Hyena).
proposal.moveEarlier: Predator from Map 6 to here: Prey means nothing without it.
proposal.note: Carnage (Dust Hyena) and Night-blind (Hoopoe, a drawback): minor, no count.
proposal.basics: Guardian ½, Ranged ½: fine with the Cobra; Quick ✓.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: The Long Grass
maps.blurb: Rolling plains and farm country — horses, hounds and village militia on every road.

proposal.theme: Farm roads: fast runners and the stampede.
proposal.minor: Converge (Border Collie herding: a felt one-off), Weapon Master (Armory, the militia), Bulldoze (Bison Bulldozer).
proposal.note: Onslaught (second skill on the Bison) and Foe's Scarcity (Stoat): minor. Herbalist came from The Sunken Grove.
proposal.basics: Ranged ½ (Talon Archer): Otter Guard (uncommon 3/5, Arrow) as village militia.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: The Aerie Vault
maps.blurb: The oldest nests on the mountain, built on top of each other for a thousand springs.

proposal.theme: The oldest nests, in the storm.
proposal.minor: Relic (Vigil Owl), Rupture (Wound Reaver).

maps.name: The Pinewood Taiga
maps.blurb: Endless dark pines on the edge of the snow — lynx, elk and the first of the wolf packs.

proposal.theme: The first wolf packs among the pines.
proposal.minor: Almanac (Cone-cutter Squirrel), Moonborn (Lunar Howler), Riled (Boreal Elk).
proposal.moveEarlier: Cleave from Map 3 (Tomcat) to here, where 3 cards carry it. Pack Leader wants a second carrier (Alpha Howler).
proposal.basics: Ranged ✗: Pinecone Crossbill (common 1/9, Flying + Arrow). Quick ✗: Pine Marten (rare 1/14, Pounce).

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: The Glimmer Depths
maps.blurb: Below the alcoves the walls start to shine, and things that like shiny things start to gather.

proposal.theme: Shiny walls and the miners they draw.
proposal.minor: Quarry (Badger Stonemason), Leech (Vampire Bat).

maps.name: Wolfsbane Tundra
maps.blurb: Frozen ground north of the grassland — the packs here hunt in formation.

proposal.theme: Frozen ground: frost that hardens you, and the hit that shatters the frozen.
proposal.minor: Hibernate (Polar Bear), Lone Wolf (a one-off against the packs), Ice Arrow (the ranged basic).
proposal.moveEarlier: Frostbite from Map 11 to here (2 carriers). Shatter needs a Freeze source beside it: keep the Walrus's Freeze as part of the pair.
proposal.moveLater: Venom Spit (Spitting Spider) to Map 6 Sable Swampmire or The Pale Desert. Ambush (Polar Bear) stays, no longer new if Map 5 takes it. Frost (field): minor.
proposal.basics: Guardian ✗: Guardian on the Harbor Seal or Beluga. Quick ✗: Quick on the Frost Hare Sprinter, or Yeti Snarer (rare 3/14, Lasso + Pounce).

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: The Glass Dunes
maps.blurb: Heat so fierce the sand turns to glass — scorpions, jackals and things that wait under the dunes.

proposal.theme: Glass sand: traps under the dunes, and hides that don't burn.
proposal.minor: Haste (Roadrunner Courier, a quick basic), Tornado (Dust-devil Kestrel, a big one-off).
proposal.moveLater: Darksight (Meerkat Burrower): minor, or to Map 8 with the dark.
proposal.basics: Ranged ½: Sand-flinger Antlion (common 2/7, Arrow; beside the Antlion Pit).

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: The Canopy
maps.blurb: Up in the rainforest roof past the savanna's edge — frogs, sloths, drums and a jaguar's path.

proposal.theme: The rainforest roof: vines and monkeys.
proposal.minor: Mighty (Hercules Beetle), Sturdy (Pangolin Roller).
proposal.basics: Ranged ½: Howler Monkey (Bananarang) or Bramblewood Macaque (Banana).

maps.name: Ashen Spurn
maps.blurb: Scorched high ground — only the toughest hides make it this far up.

proposal.theme: Scorched high ground: heat that feeds the fire-born.
proposal.minor: Spitfire (Fire Salamander, ranged), Scare (Yeti: a one-off).
proposal.note: Recoil, Scar and Mighty: minor, no count (Mighty came from The Canopy).
proposal.basics: Guardian ✗: Guardian on the Granite Ox Golem. Quick ✗: Quick on the Talus Pika.

flags: no clear signature (no new skill on 2+ cards)

maps.name: The Pale Desert
maps.blurb: Past the glass the sand turns white as bone, and so does the sun. No water, no shade, and the horizon never stays where you left it.

proposal.theme: White desert, no rain.

maps.name: The Sundered Peak
maps.blurb: The mountain’s broken crown — apex predators, and no scouts left to send ahead of you.

proposal.theme: The broken crown: the dead keep the fire company, and the carrion birds circle.
proposal.minor: Requiem (Cinder Skeleton, beside Undead), Remember (Ashbone Ghoul).
proposal.moveEarlier: Scavenge from Map 12 (Carrion Crow) to here, beside Carrion.
proposal.note: Fire Arrow (2 carriers) counts as a ranged basic, not a signature.
proposal.basics: Guardian ½ (Alpine Marmot): fine.

maps.name: Eye of the Volcano
maps.blurb: Down inside the crater, where the dead keep the fire company and the living learned not to need much.

proposal.theme: Inside the crater: no new skill.
proposal.basics: Guardian ✗ and Quick ✗: optional for a side map.

maps.name: Volcano Lair
maps.blurb: Where the mountain's fire is born. Something vast sleeps in it, and it is waking.

proposal.theme: Where the fire is born: a forecast fireball.
proposal.minor: Frenzy (Ember Jackal).
proposal.basics: Guardian ✗: optional for a side map.
